meta: Oral exams are scary because you don't know what the examiner will ask, but AI can play the examiner so you can rehearse out loud and get feedback at the end.

muc.title: Oral exams
muc.text: Oral exams are scary because you don't know what the examiner will ask, but you can ask AI to play the examiner and practice first.

muc.title: Make AI the examiner
muc.text: Tell AI: you're the examiner for this subject, ask me one question at a time, wait for my answer before asking the next, and dig into anywhere my answer is vague.

muc.title: Practice out loud
muc.text: Use voice chat mode to practice saying it out loud, because thinking it in your head and saying it are very different.

muc.title: Ask for feedback at the end
muc.text: At the end, ask AI to grade each answer and point out what you missed, then review exactly those parts.

muc.title: Fifteen minutes of oral practice
muc.text: Pick three chapters for the exam, make AI the examiner, and answer out loud for fifteen minutes without looking at your notes.
